articles.summary: We are proud to congratulate Dr. Jocelyn Chertoff, member of the Varex Imaging Board of Directors, on being named an RSNA 2026 Gold Medalist. The RSNA Gold Medal is the Radiological Society of North America’s highest honor, recognizing individuals who have rendered exceptional service to the science of radiology. articles.title: Varex Imaging Board of Directors Member, Dr. Jocelyn Chertoff wins RSNA Gold Medal
